measurement.groups: 前回と同じハーネス。未圧縮コピーを計時前に準備するcold、1回列挙後のwarmを区別し、process CPU時間を測る。初回7反復、懸念条件と代表改善条件を21反復で再確認。
measurement.shapes: 通常平衡・任意番号・葉先順。複数成分は成分サイズ16/256。
measurement.types: int64、独立modint998244353。正しさモデルは小型unsigned・カウント付き汎用型も含む。

decisions.idea: link時に読み出した根の負サイズを保持し、重み代入後に再読込せず合計を使う。Type演算とrootのtieを維持。
decisions.result: 同じmainの中央値合計比が約0.993〜1.013。GCC15.3通常は約1.3%増で、全設定に安定した短縮はなく不採用。

decisions.idea: Clangの一成分の既存走査をnoinline helperへ分ける。演算順と所有を維持しGCCは前処理で完全同一。
decisions.result: 一成分の代表条件で約4〜6%短縮が再現。一方、複数成分のClang native/int64(成分16通常cold)が約2.3%、Clang native/Mod(成分256任意番号cold)が約2.6%増。両controlは約±0.3%以内。既存条件の速さを維持するため不採用。

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,importlib.util,shutil
p=Path(__file__).parent;o=p/'main_compare';o.mkdir(exist_ok=True);r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('prepare',r/'Scripts/prepare_verify.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
main=(p/'baseline/main.cpp').read_text().replace(m.FAST_IO_INCLUDE,(p/'baseline/fast_io.hpp').read_text());main=m.expand_acl(main)
cs={'gcc152':['/usr/bin/g++'],'gcc152native':['/usr/bin/g++','-march=native'],'gcc153':['/usr/local/bin/g++'],'gcc153native':['/usr/local/bin/g++','-march=native'],'clang':['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15'],'clangnative':['clang++','--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15','-march=native']};vs={'baseline':p/'baseline/library.hpp','control':p/'baseline/library.hpp','cached':p/'link_cached.hpp'};builds=[];identity=[]
for cc,c in cs.items():
 hashes={}
 for v,h in vs.items():
  out=o/f'{cc}-{v}'
  if v=='control':shutil.copyfile(o/f'{cc}-baseline',out);hashes[v]=hashes['baseline'];continue
  src=o/f'{v}.cpp';src.write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n'+h.read_text()+main);cmd=['taskset','-c','4',*c,'-std=c++23','-O2',str(src),'-o',str(out)];a=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert a.returncode==0,a.stderr;builds.append(dict(cc=cc,variant=v,source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(h.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),command=cmd));sec=Path(str(out)+'.text');subprocess.run(['objcopy','--dump-section',f'.text={sec}',str(out)],check=True);hashes[v]=hashlib.sha256(sec.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 identity.append(dict(cc=cc,text_sha256=hashes,identical=hashes['baseline']==hashes['cached']));print('weighted main built',cc,identity[-1]['identical'],flush=True)
(o/'builds.json').write_text(json.dumps(builds,indent=2));(o/'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,random,shutil,statistics,resource,time,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;o=p/'main_compare';up=Path('/tmp/rwuf_round2_20261030/official_potential');rng=random.Random(710874);raw=[]
for cc in ['gcc152','gcc152native','gcc153','gcc153native','clang','clangnative']:
 for f in sorted(up.glob('*.in')):
  expected=f.with_suffix('.out').read_bytes().split()
  for rep in range(9):
   order=['baseline','control','cached'];rng.shuffle(order)
   for v in order:
    active=o/'active';shutil.copyfile(o/f'{cc}-{v}',active);active.chmod(0o755)
    with f.open('rb')as file:
     before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.perf_counter_ns();a=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','12',str(active)],stdin=file,capture_output=True);wall=time.perf_counter_ns()-start;after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    assert a.returncode==0 and a.stdout.split()==expected,(cc,f.name,v,a.stderr);raw.append(dict(cc=cc,case=f.name,rep=rep,variant=v,cpu_ns=round((after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime)*1e9),wall_ns=wall,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(a.stdout).hexdigest()))
 print('main measured',cc,flush=True)
(o/'raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(raw,indent=2));s=[]
for cc,case in sorted({(x['cc'],x['case'])for x in raw}):
 med={v:statistics.median(x['cpu_ns']for x in raw if x['cc']==cc and x['case']==case and x['variant']==v)for v in ['baseline','control','cached']};s.append(dict(cc=cc,case=case,median_cpu_ns=med,ratios={v:med[v]/max(med['baseline'],1)for v in med}))
(o/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(s,indent=2));print('MAIN DONE',len(raw),flush=True)
